result_text:
Promotions now carry an optional description, and it comes back from every listing and lookup you named. The full suite passes: 607 tests, 0 failures.

- **`model/Promotion.java`**: added `String description` as the last record component.
- **`src/main/resources/schema.sql`**: added `description VARCHAR(200)` to `promotion`. Nullable, so older promotions have none.
- **`service/PromotionService.java`**: `createPromotion` has a new 6-argument overload that takes the description last. A blank description is stored as null, the same way blank categories are handled. The existing 5-argument version is kept and delegates with no description, so the many existing callers and tests are unchanged.
- **`DataStore.java`**: `createPromotion` writes the description. `findPromotionByCode`, `listPromotionsActiveOn`, `listPromotionsActiveOnInRegion`, `listPromotionsByCategory`, `findBestPromotion` and `listUnusedPromotions` select it and map it into the record.

I did not add a test that checks the SUMMER example end to end, so the description round-trip is verified by reading the code, not by a dedicated test. Nothing is committed.
